_comment: Congestion-hypothesis confirmation: core_edge onephase at --bw 1 (vs baseline 10 Mbps). Hypothesis: PrefixSync flood saturates links, dropping DV heartbeats and causing FIB resets. At 1 Mbps, the small topology that normally scales 1:1 should exhibit the same sub-linear FIB growth seen in rocketfuel_1755 at 10 Mbps. Run with: sudo ./jobs.sh start --fresh prefix_scale/core_edge_onephase_bw1_3stage
name: core_edge_onephase_bw1_3stage
description: Hypothesis confirmation: core_edge onephase at 1 Mbps. FIB should be sub-linear if congestion is the root cause.
